scenarios.title: Hide Tasks from the sidebar context menu, then restore it with the real macOS View > Show Tasks Button item; its checkmark follows both the native click and a scripted setting change, and standard Edit menu shortcuts still work.
scenarios.summary: Hide from sidebar and a scripted setting change both move the native View > Show Tasks Button checkmark, but the harness can't click the macOS menu bar to restore through it.

scenarios.title: Copy an issue or Project link in the real macOS window: system clipboard contains the exact GitHub URL; denial shows failure rather than success.
scenarios.summary: Needs a GitHub-hosted fixture; the isolated run's repo has no remote or credentials (Tasks: no origin remote).

scenarios.title: Open an issue, repository or Project view on GitHub from the real macOS window: the system browser receives the exact HTTP(S) target without credentials or unrelated navigation.
scenarios.summary: Needs a GitHub-hosted fixture; the isolated run's repo has no remote or credentials (Tasks: no origin remote).

scenarios.title: Start or Resume a linked workspace from Tasks and issue detail: the real Quirky window activates the correct workspace and keyboard focus, without raising a different application.
scenarios.summary: Needs a linked GitHub issue workspace; the isolated run's repo has no remote or credentials.
